text:
marta: Hey team — quick design check. Working on a compact ‘range compare’ strip that sits above the heatmap for quick p95/throughput eyeballs. Goal: let SREs compare two time ranges without changing the whole dashboard. Rough mock attached: https://files.redwood/mock-range-compact.png

sam: Love the idea. Does the strip sync with the main chart when you hover?

marta: Yes — hover on the strip should highlight the corresponding window on the heatmap and the p95 line chart. Quick behavior notes: single-click pins a range (persistent), double-click clears.

jin: Two UX questions: (1) how do we show sampling? (2) what happens if the compare range overlaps the live range?

marta: For sampling I sketched a small badge on the strip: `S: 1/10` (meaning 1 in 10 requests sampled). Clicking it opens sampler settings. For overlap — we fade the older range and draw an outline for the overlap region + tooltip that says "overlap — combined stats".

alex: Copy nit: instead of `S:` maybe use `Sample rate:` in the tooltip and keep the badge `1/10` minimal. Also consider an affordance to temporarily disable sampling from the strip without going to settings.

lee: Accessibility nits: make sure the strip has a 3:1 contrast ratio against background when focused. Keyboard: allow `←/→` to shift the pinned range, `enter` to pin, `esc` to clear. Also add an ARIA label like `aria-label="Compare time range control, p95 and throughput strip"`.

sam: Implementation note: the strip should be a semantic `role="slider"`? Might be awkward — maybe `role="group"` with the ranges as `role="button"` so screen readers can activate them.

jin: Analytics question: if people pin two ranges we should log an event `range.compare` with fields: `base_start, base_end, compare_start, compare_end, sample_rate`. Will help correlate regressions.

marta: Agree. UI mock updated with a tiny legend: base (solid), compare (dashed), overlap (outlined). Also added a microcopy under the strip: "Pin ranges to compare p95 & throughput. Use keyboard to nudge." Thoughts on phrasing?

alex: Shorter: "Pin ranges to compare p95 & throughput. Use ←/→ to nudge." Good call.

lee: A11y follow-up: ensure focus rings are visible at 3px and not just color change. Also test with high-zoom and TalkBack/VoiceOver flows.

sam: Dev question: do we want sampling changes to be global per-dashboard or per-user? Per-user seems safer for experiments.

marta: Per-user for now; product will decide later. I'll add a small text link: "Apply to all dashboards" behind an advanced setting.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `feature/compact-range-strip` — CI: 3/4 passing, failing test: `dashboard-heatmap-integration.test.js`

sam: I'll take that test. Also: proposed CSS for the strip (WIP):
```
.range-strip { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; padding:6px; background:var(--bg-1); }
.range-badge { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04); padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; }
```

marta: Thanks — next steps: Sam fixes failing test, Jin adds analytics event, Lee runs quick a11y checklist on the prototype, Alex to sign-off copy. I'll update the mock with the `Sample rate` tooltip and keyboard hint.

alex: SGTM. Can we get a final screenshot by EOD tomorrow for the docs PR?

marta: Yep — will post in this thread when ready :sparkles:
